tips.body: Track to-dos, assign work, manage projects. Actions have kanban columns, priorities, and deadlines.
tips.title: Actions are tasks

actions.create: Enter task description, set project, assign to a contact, set deadline.

field_help.priority: Higher number = higher priority. 1 = low, 5 = urgent.
field_help.dt_deadline: When this task is due. Shows in red when overdue.
field_help.kanban_column: backlog → todo → in_progress → review → done. Drag in Kanban view.

tips.body: A contact is both a user account and a person. They link to orgs (customer, vendor, rep) and communications (email, phone).
tips.title: Contacts link everything

tips.body: A contact can be linked to a customer, vendor, rep, and employee simultaneously.
tips.title: One contact, many hats

actions.create: Enter email (required), first/last name, company. Set role for access control.

warnings: Deleting a contact removes their login. Use is_active=false to disable instead.

field_help.role: admin, manager, sales, warehouse, accounting, customer, vendor, rep.
field_help.email: Login email — also used as the primary communication email.
field_help.company: Company affiliation — may differ from org.display_name.

tips.body: Every order, invoice, proposal, and payment links to a customer. Start here.
tips.title: Customers are the center

tips.body: The same contact can have multiple org relationships. Check the contact record to see all hats.
tips.title: A customer can also be a vendor

tips.body: Retail, wholesale, distributor, sample — the price level on the customer flows to orders and invoices automatically.
tips.title: Price levels matter

actions.order: From a customer, click "New Order" to create an order pre-linked to this customer.
actions.create: Enter display name and status. Save. Then add communications (email, phone, address) in the Communications tab.
actions.statement: Click "Statement" to generate an AR statement showing open invoices and aging.

warnings: Deleting a customer does NOT delete their orders/invoices. Those become orphaned.

field_help.email: Primary email — click the label to compose. Synced from communications.
field_help.phone: Primary phone — click the label to dial. Synced from communications.
field_help.terms: Payment terms (N30, COD, 2/10 Net 30). Sets when payment is due.
field_help.status: active = doing business. prospect = potential. inactive = paused. retired = closed.
field_help.attention: Who to address correspondence to at this organization.
field_help.price_level: Determines which price tier is used on orders/invoices for this customer.
field_help.address_full: Primary address — click the label to open in Google Maps.
field_help.display_name: The primary name shown in lists and on printed documents.

tips.body: planned → released → complete. Only released invoices appear on statements and can be posted to GL.
tips.title: Invoice lifecycle

tips.body: Balance = Total - Payments. When it reaches 0, the invoice is fully paid.
tips.title: Balance tracks payments

tips.body: Once posted, you can only reverse — not edit. Post when the invoice is final.
tips.title: GL posting is one-way

actions.print: Click Reports (🖨) button → Invoice. Opens printable format.
actions.create: Select a customer, set status to planned, add line items with items and quantities.
actions.gl_post: On the invoice toolbar, click Post GL. Creates journal entries by account code.
actions.payment: Go to Payments → Apply Payments. Select this invoice, enter amount.

warnings: Don't manually set status to 'complete' — let the system do it when balance reaches 0.
GL posting creates permanent journal entries. Review totals before posting.

field_help.terms: Payment terms — determines due date on the ledger record.
field_help.total: Sum of all line items. Edit lines to change — total recalculates automatically.
field_help.status: planned = draft. released = sent to customer. complete = paid and closed.
field_help.balance: Total minus payments received. Read-only. Updated when payments are applied.
field_help.price_level: Price tier used for line item pricing on this invoice.

code_examples.code:
const res = await getRecord('invoice', id);
const lines = res.record.lines;
code_examples.title: Get invoice with lines

code_examples.code: const res = await getRecords('invoice', { status: 'released', ordering: 'dt_created' });
code_examples.title: List overdue invoices

tips.body: Every line on an order, invoice, or PO references an item. Items have prices, costs, and inventory.
tips.title: Items are what you sell and buy

tips.body: The real metric: (margin × annual turns) ÷ carry cost. High velocity = productive inventory.
tips.title: Margin velocity

actions.create: Enter SKU, name, kind, UOM. Set prices in the price JSON. Set costs in cost JSON.

warnings: Changing an item SKU after it appears on orders/invoices can break references.

field_help.sku: Stock keeping unit — your internal product code.
field_help.uom: Unit of measure — ea, lb, ft, box, etc.
field_help.kind: product = physical goods. service = labor/time. bundle = kit of items.
field_help.name: Display name shown on documents and in search.
field_help.status: active = available for sale. discontinued = no longer sold.
field_help.price_level: Prices stored in the price JSON by level (retail, wholesale, distributor).

tips.body: received = money in (customer pays us). disbursed = money out (we pay vendor). Same model, different type.
tips.title: Two types of payments

tips.body: Applying a payment to an invoice reduces its balance. When balance = 0, invoice is paid.
tips.title: Payments reduce balance

actions.apply: Go to Apply Payments to match a payment to an invoice.
actions.reconcile: After bank statement arrives, mark payments as reconciled.

warnings: Disbursed payments should link to a purchase order via the purchase field.

field_help.type: received = AR (customer pays us). disbursed = AP (we pay vendor/employee).
field_help.status: pending = entered. completed = processed. failed = rejected.
field_help.gateway: manual = entered by hand. stripe/paypal = processed by gateway.
field_help.reference_number: Check number, transaction ID, or other external reference.

code_examples.title: Record payment received

tips.body: An order is a commitment to deliver. It can generate pick lists, packing slips, and invoices.
tips.title: Orders drive fulfillment

tips.body: When an order is fulfilled, convert it to an invoice. Lines carry over automatically.
tips.title: Order → Invoice flow

actions.pick: Click Reports (🖨) → Pick/Pull Request for warehouse picking list.
actions.create: Select customer, add line items. Each line needs an item and quantity.
actions.convert: To invoice: use the order-to-invoice conversion flow.

warnings: Changing an order after pick lists are printed can cause fulfillment errors.

field_help.total: Sum of line items. Recalculates when lines are added/changed.
field_help.status: planned = not started. released = being fulfilled. complete = shipped/delivered.
field_help.priority: Helps warehouse sort what to pick first.

tips.body: A proposal is a price quote sent to a customer. If accepted, it converts to an order.
tips.title: Proposals are quotes

tips.body: Proposal lines show both MSRP and the offered unit price so the customer sees the discount.
tips.title: MSRP vs Unit Price

actions.print: Reports (🖨) → Proposal/Quote for professional printable format.
actions.create: Select customer, add line items with items, quantities, and pricing.
actions.convert: If customer accepts, convert proposal to order.

field_help.total: Proposed total — what the customer would pay if they accept.
field_help.status: planned = draft. released = sent to customer. complete = accepted or expired.

tips.body: A purchase order is sent to a vendor to buy goods. It tracks what you ordered vs what you received.
tips.title: Purchases go to vendors

tips.body: Receive goods against the PO, then create a disbursement (payment type=disbursed) to pay the vendor.
tips.title: PO → Receiving → Payment

actions.email: Reports (🖨) → PO Email to Vendor sends the PO as PDF.
actions.create: Select vendor, add line items with items and quantities.
actions.receive: When goods arrive, record receiving against the PO lines.

warnings: Receiving more than ordered creates overstock. Check quantities.

field_help.total: Total cost of all purchase lines.
field_help.status: planned = draft. released = sent to vendor. complete = fully received.
